summary: Camiguin representative with 85 principal-authored bills. Authored bank transparency and anti-corruption mechanisms, waste treatment regulation and overhead utility line rules. Co-authored stronger NFA regulatory powers, crop insurance expansion, enhanced senior and PWD discounts, a tertiary education subsidy reform and energy storage frameworks.
caveat: Economic score rests only on co-authored bills; bank transparency is a single institutions issue.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored stronger NFA regulatory powers and crop insurance expansion (-2, state role in agriculture) and enhanced senior and PWD discounts (-2). All co-authored.
